samples.title: Ten percent you can do in your head
samples.subject: Mathematical Literacy
samples.script: Forget the calculator for a second. Ten percent of anything? Move the comma one step. Ten percent of two hundred and forty rand airtime is twenty-four rand. Five percent is half of that - twelve rand. Fifteen percent? Twenty-four plus twelve - thirty-six rand. You just did the till-slip discount in your head while the queue was still moving. Estimate first, then let the calculator confirm you were close. If the machine says something wild, your head catches the slip before your money does.
